newsitem.title: USA: Valhi transfers control of sugar unit.
newsitem.headline: Valhi transfers control of sugar unit.

text.p: Valhi Inc said on Friday that it completed the transfer of control of its refined sugar business to Snake River Sugar Co, an Oregon cooperative of the refined sugar business previously conducted by a Valhi unit.

Under the deal, Amalgamated Sugar Co, an indirect wholly owned Valhi subsidiary, received an interest in The Amalgamated Sugar Company LLC, a limited liability company controlled by Snake River, with an agreed value of $250 million.

Valhi received about $82 million net cash, including fourth quarter dividends from Amalgamated of $21 million. Valhi is entitle to receive certain distributions from the limited liability partnership.
